seed_data_creation: Test reminders created and cleaned up during testing with TEST_ prefix
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 tested three new features: 1) Email-based lead delivery - GET /api/settings/lead-email returns @leads.breamway.com address, POST /api/settings/lead-email/regenerate creates new address, POST /api/leads/email-incoming parses plain-text email format. 2) Reminder Calendar - full CRUD at /api/reminders with types (pickup, dispatch, follow_up, custom), date range filters, today endpoint, admin sees all users' reminders. 3) Vendor API route fix - /api/leads/specs and /api/leads/incoming now work correctly (route ordering fixed). Admin Panel has Lead Delivery Email section with format template. Reminders page has calendar grid, today banner, and reminder list with actions.

email_lead_delivery.email_incoming: POST /api/leads/email-incoming - parses plain-text key:value format, requires X-API-Key
email_lead_delivery.email_format: Name, Pickup City/State/Zip, Delivery City/State/Zip, Year/Make/Model, Pickup Date, Running, Email, Phone, Phone 2, Notes, Lead Source ID#

reminder_calendar.create: POST /api/reminders - title, notes, reminder_date, reminder_type, order_number, quote_number
reminder_calendar.list: GET /api/reminders - filters: start_date, end_date, user_id, status
reminder_calendar.update: PUT /api/reminders/{id} - user can edit own, admin can edit all
reminder_calendar.delete: DELETE /api/reminders/{id} - user can delete own, admin can delete all

admin_panel_ui.lead_email_section: Shows email address, copy button, regenerate button
admin_panel_ui.vendor_docs_link: Copy Link and Open Docs buttons

reminders_page_ui.reminders_list: Below calendar with Mark Done, Edit, Delete actions
reminders_page_ui.add_dialog: Title, Date, Type, Order #, Quote #, Notes fields

mocked_apis.note: Email delivery is simulated - CRM generates @leads.breamway.com address and provides POST endpoint. Actual email server forwarding needs separate setup.
